## Key Dates

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics will release Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for September 2026 on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The report will provide the latest reading on US consumer inflation, coming roughly two weeks before the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets on October 28, 2026, for its next rate decision.

## FOMC Meeting

The committee meets on 27 and 28 October with no Summary of Economic Projections, and the September personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index arrives on 29 October, the morning after. Pricing into the month is close to a coin toss: fed funds futures put 47.1 percent on a further increase on 28 October against 52.9 percent on no change.

## Additional Economic Data

The committee will have the September employment report on 2 October, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on 14 October and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on 15 October.

## Crypto Market Impact

Bitcoin moved a median 1.5% on CPI days, against 1.2% on other days, about 1.2× a normal session. This indicates that crypto markets can experience heightened volatility around inflation data releases and FOMC decisions.
